fusions.name: Scattered Flint
fusions.desc: Scatters 4 flint caltrops in a spread out to 4 tiles. Each caltrop deals 2 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Propped Slab
fusions.desc: Knocks the prop from a slab of rock above the target. It deals 34 damage to the target and 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Covered Pit
fusions.desc: Digs a covered pit at the nearest enemy that arms after 1 second and waits up to 30 seconds. Each of the first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles drops it: the pit deals 18 damage to everything within 3 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: The Ground Remembers
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, a spike of stone strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
